title: Cover detached launcher admission in the early-terminal execution guard
outcome: The Ordinary-disposition guard has a deterministic regression that fails if detached full-gate launch success is treated as execution completion.
acceptance: A simple full launcher --detach reporting Code(0) or ReportedSuccess cannot set an early execution terminal or release the running key for a later check; the test fails if the Ordinary guard is removed.
A normal coded foreground terminal retains expected behavior, including an optional nonzero-Code control.
The exact changed input has required green checks and independent review.
